defaults.nanite: keep; WPO meshes need 'Evaluate World Position Offset' on (programmable raster)

wpo_cloth.what: normal-direction ripple, weighted by distance from the pinned edge, phase from world position + GustPhase

wpo_pivot_sway.what: rigid rotation about the mesh's top edge (object bounds), axis perpendicular to WindDirection

wpo_wheel_creak.what: rigid rotation of a few degrees about the axle through the bounds centre, driven by the gust (snaps back slowly)

wpo_rotor.what: continuous rotation of the vertices inside the rotor sphere (local-space mask) about the hub axis; rate = base x WindStrength x gust

wpo_mast_bend.what: cantilever bend, offset = amp x z01^2 along WindDirection

cable_new.what: NEW thin guy-wire meshes (a 16-ring tube, imported from an offline OBJ); catenary sway = amp x sin(pi x t) along the wire

card_dust_wisp.what: NEW 2 x 4 m translucent unlit card (Plane) at the stack top: panning noise, depth fade, alpha gated by gust; ash/dust lifted off the stack, never smoke

card_dust_sift.what: NEW 1 x 3 m vertical card under a broken edge: a thin fall of grit that appears only in gusts (alpha = saturate(gust - 0.6) x 3)

ps_glint.what: pixel-shader emissive glint when the sun-mirror-camera angle lines up (dot of reflected sun and view > 0.995), plus a slow 0.3 deg WPO wobble

rotating_component.what: URotatingMovementComponent, bUpdateOnlyIfRendered true; the actor must be Movable
